title: Settings
padNone: No controller detected. You can use the keyboard. Press any controller button to wake it.

layouts.ROV_USA: ROV standard: left pitch/yaw, right surge/roll
layouts.UAV_CHN: ROV twin-stick: left surge/sway, right heave/yaw

controllerSettings: Advanced controller settings: deadzone, curves, bindings and mapping wizard

intro: Opening sequence from surface deployment to submersion, played at the start of every dive and skippable while it plays. Disabling also skips pre-dive checks.
pip: Show the surface operator in a corner of the screen.
fog: Disabling makes water clearer than a real camera image.
